transport_review.finding: ASCII strings/keys, null/bool, safe integers +/- (2^53-1), nested arrays/objects supported. Floats, non-ASCII, raw binary and duplicate keys rejected. Nested structure itself is not a gap.
Admitted flat ASCII snapshots fit. Upstream Unicode/UTF-8/Uint8Array cases outside fixture subset; no universal serializer claim.
Digest fixtures fit; general UTF-8 judgment and signed-verdict v1 text can exceed ASCII. Exact bytes cannot be silently normalized.
Admitted probes fit. Upstream encoder qualification covers richer JS numbers/UTF-16 ordering. Qualification does not expand RSI fixture transport.
Timestamps and hex fit. Signature/anchor binary may require explicit exact-byte carriers; carrying bytes is not verification.
uint256 can exceed safe integer; UTF-8 resultText/Solidity source and ABI bytes require explicit lossless profile carriers. No silent coercion.
MPT/RLP bytes and BigInt may use exact hex/decimal-string carriers under future explicit validation; independent decoding required.
Prospective integer bps fits; historical float-4dp vectors do not. Never relabel/round historical artifacts into new convention.
UTF-8 scope/receipt inputs can exceed ASCII. Digest references preserve byte identity but do not establish semantic authority.
